activity_statements.statement: operates the largest public health system in the United States, providing acute care, primary care, specialty care, behavioral health, and long-term care to New York City residents
provides health care services to all NYC residents regardless of ability to pay or immigration status through a network of public hospitals, community health centers, and skilled nursing facilities
delivers short-term rehabilitation therapy and long-term skilled nursing care with physicians on-site 24/7 at facilities such as NYC Health + Hospitals/Coler
operates as a New York Public Benefit Corporation under the governance of the City of New York, funded by a combination of Medicaid, Medicare, and city subsidies

name_reality_gap: none - the name and 'Hospitals & Health Care' index label accurately describe the organization. The less obvious reality is that as the US's largest public health system, it functions as a city-subsidized safety-net insurer and social services gateway as much as a clinical delivery system.
extraction_notes: The about URL landed on the Coler (skilled nursing) facility page rather than the organization-level about page, providing some but incomplete organizational coverage. Profile supplemented with publicly known information about NYC H+H as the largest US public health system. Extraction confidence moderate due to limited source.
